# Forced versions that win over what packages declare (uv pip install --override).
# ROS 2 Humble's message libraries are built for numpy 1.x and fail to load
# under numpy 2, and our ROS nodes run in this environment. OpenCV 4.11+
# requires numpy 2, so it is held at 4.10 (LeRobot allows >=4.9).
# Known, accepted: rerun-sdk (LeRobot's live viewer for teleop and dataset
# recording, which we do not use) declares numpy>=2; it still imports.
numpy<2
opencv-python-headless<4.11
